title: Traffic Survey Application Suite
description: A modular, offline-first progressive web application suite for multi-module traffic field data collection, built around a shared data-capture engine that queues events locally and synchronizes them to a Google Apps Script backend in batches, keeping a multi-hour field session within a free-tier execution quota that per-event requests alone would exceed.
